## Tool and user need

Who would use this and what problem would it solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the experience, including small displays and accessibility where relevant. Link an existing roadmap/design if one applies.

## Scope and success checks

What is included, what can wait, and how would we know it works?

## Artwork or dependencies

List new services/assets and their source/license, if needed. Prefer original artwork and browser-only operation.
